Plug in: no fin hold - pinch the 6S half's ends ((c)), push along d: the push goes into the fork and the wall tops.

J18_6S_sense.source: 6S balance plug JST-XH 7: the pin that reads the FULL pack voltage against the XT60 minus (multimeter first; usually the end pin opposite the black wire) -> ONE owned female-male Dupont jumper: female on J18 pin 1, male 0.64 pin into that XH socket - no cutting.  Reference: board GND = 6S minus through the ESC JR ground at J12 (A: check continuity JR minus <-> XT60 minus with a multimeter)
J18_6S_sense.firmware_M: required, not optional: battery builds read V_in on PF0 (params_gen.h VBAT_ADC_CHANNEL 0, VBAT_V_PER_COUNT 0.0275, 6 cells); core/onboard.c refuses ARM below 3.30 V / cell (LP_REJ_VCELL) and interlocks_ballistic aborts POWERED below it (I8: motor off) -> J18 open = the rocket cannot arm; a jumper that falls out in flight cuts the motor
